name: Le Havre, the City Rebuilt by Auguste Perret
description: Le Havre is a Channel port in Normandy whose centre was flattened by bombing in the Second World War. Between 1945 and 1964, architect Auguste Perret and his team rebuilt it in concrete, using prefabricated parts laid out on a strict modular grid. Walking its straight avenues and uniform blocks today, you see a whole city planned as one design, echoing the older street pattern.
